recommendation: Keep the audit commit and do not re-add OccupationalData to core for this seed. Future occupational data work should proceed via the ODH profiles/IG or a new work-group decision rather than reviving the superseded draft resource.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue requesting addition of the OccupationalData resource per the Occupational Data for Health proposal, with Jira recording the addition as pre-applied in December 2017 and applied for R5.
initial_application: The request was applied in historical GF#14337 commits: fa656ae1d9 added a draft resource stub, 43bb1f0626 completed the initial build, and subsequent GF#14337 commits updated structure, examples, and documentation. Dormant source/occupationaldata files remain as inactive remnants of that work.
additional_context: FHIR-16930 and FHIR-14868 later reached Published/Persuasive withdrawal decisions, concluding OccupationalData should not exist as a core resource and should instead be handled through questionnaires, logical models, and principally Observations. Commit efef182022 removed active fhir.ini mappings, and existing combined-branch commit 9ee22091 removed the stale Resource Guide row. Zulip and PHWG minutes align the seed with this later withdrawal family.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed for FHIR-14337 because the target combined branch has no active OccupationalData fhir.ini entry, retains only the dropped-resource note, and no longer has current non-history/non-dormant source references presenting OccupationalData as available.

related_jiras.note: Later Published/Persuasive decision withdrew OccupationalData as a core resource; already represented on the combined branch by commit 9ee22091.
Published/Persuasive ballot comment with the same withdrawal rationale and a resolution note to see FHIR-16930.
Earlier naming/profile issue noted further consideration of whether OccupationalData should be a resource or profile.
